question: Does a retained radial-profile mesh remove topology work while allowing clear silhouette, closure, angular resolution and appearance edits through one ordinary P3D drawing loop?
decision: select or revise supplied-profile mesh boundary before public contract; no default or encouraged range claim

parameter.name: supplied radial profile and angular tessellation
parameter.unit: local Cartesian distance and angular cell count

baseline.lighting: Processing lights(), explicit flat per-triangle unit normals

variants.change: only radius profile becomes60-36*cos((j/16-.5)*PI); same z and cells; whole-profile design substitution
only radius profile becomes60*(1-j/16), last radius exact0; endpoint pole replaces positive-ring cap
both positive-ring cap closures removed; grouped closure comparison
palette only; exact retained baseline mesh object
retained baseline,waist,pointed meshes each scaled.45 at x140,320,500,y320 with same rotations; composition transfer not isolated parameter effect

comparison: Exact retained geometry hashes and topology records before rendering; fixed camera/lighting for first six images; objective pixel differences plus root inspection of all seven. No source pixel reproduction.
acceptance: One rendering loop serves all profiles without repairing or reconstructing mesh connectivity.
Waist and pointed profile substitutions visibly change silhouette without changing palette or camera.
Lower angular resolution demonstrates the angular facet control; no continuous useful range inferred.
Caps/poles/seam have correct orientation and no missing-face cracks in selected views.
Recolour uses exact retained mesh identity; transformed placement reuses the same meshes.
Flat normal computation remains understandable rendering glue; revise core boundary if usable lighting requires caller mesh algorithms.
constraints: one root-registered seven-image attempt only after code, counts, bindings and P3D runtime result reviewed
no public library implementation or candidate merge authorized
maximum10000generatedfaces preflight, outputs remain in ignored .work
all7images must be inspected; failures preserved

stderr_policy.allowed: empty stderr, or exactly the complete7line libEGL DRI3 plus X11Util3open-display shutdown block captured in the P3D probe; only display numbers and native hexaddresses may vary
stderr_policy.limits: Accepting these environment diagnostics for this private comparison does not pass the original strict probe, prove hardware acceleration, or establish clean renderer lifecycle.

Read complete executor, reconciled actual native status and plan warning record; preflight compiled and inspected successfully.
Tested warning matcher accepts exact observed block or empty stderr, rejects extra warnings, changed shutdown counts and GLException.
Bound7images/4496generatedfaces/8784drawnfaces and normal evaluations; no rerender or missing-case exclusion.
